description:
Security developer needed to construct an application which will embed secure hyperlinks to documents for an eFiling project.

 Programming Languages/Development Tools: Visual Studio/C#/VB (5 years’ experience); SSIS/BIDS (5 years’ experience); TSQL/SQL Server (5 years’ experience)
 Database Systems/Database Tools: MS SQL Server 2008-2014 (5 years’ experience); Non-Relational (No SQL) DBs (1 year experience)
 Frameworks/SDLs/Methodologies: .NET Framework, WCF, C#, VB>NET 4.0, XML (5 years’ experience); CCMI (5 years’ experience)
 Misc. Applications: MQ Series (5 years’ experience); SOAP, REST (5 years’ experience) 
 Operating Systems/Environment: Windows (5 years’ experience); Powershell (1 year experience)
 Other Skills: REST, OWIN, JWT, OpenID Connect and Azure AD.

 Additional Information :  
 - "All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines". 
 - All candidates who are authorized to work in US are encouraged to apply.
 - Candidates must clear the Background check prior to commencing the assignment. 
 
 
 THIRD PARTY CANDIDATES: 

 Email your candidate/s resume to   joseph dot shelton at idealforce.com  along with the following details: Rate, Current location and Availability.
